english.note: This is the colloquial choice when the malicious intent is understood from the context, as in deliberately trying to hurt or trick someone.

examples.english: They maliciously brought up my painful past in front of everyone.
examples.traditional: 佢有心喺人哋面前揭我瘡疤。
